entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working correctly.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical thing. The heart rate monitor is all over the place. Honestly, the thing is just garbage. I don't have time to try and fix it, I just want my money back.

I understand your frustration. Sometimes a quick software reset can fix that specific issue. If you'd like, we could try that, or I can transfer you to our technical support team who are experts with the Pulse.
No, no, I'm not good with all that. I really don't have time for a transfer and a whole other call. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
Okay, I understand. You're looking for a simple resolution. Let me pull up our return policy for you. Can you confirm when you received the VeloBand?
Umm, it was a while ago. Maybe 40 days or so? Around the middle of December, I think.

Alright, thank you. Let me just check the system here... One moment... Okay, I see your order. Yes, it looks like you received it about 40 days ago. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can return it?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account as we speak. You should have it in the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's great! Thank you so much. I was so worried and confused about what to do.

It's my pleasure to help. And since you're one of our VIP members, I've also gone ahead and added a $15 VeloFit credit to your account for the trouble. Once we receive the band back at our warehouse, you'll see the full refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you, David!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
